selection_metric: mean validation balanced accuracy across CAR/Pz/FCz and probe seeds
tie_break_rule: choose the smaller lambda on an exact validation tie

selected_vs_augmentation.bootstrap_unit: probe seed and paired test subject
selected_vs_augmentation.decision_rule: supported requires every consistency run to pass the predeclared recovery/clean gate and the hierarchical 95% CI for recall-gap recovery to be above zero; a positive point estimate with a crossing CI is promising_but_inconclusive.

interpretation_rule: The selected lambda is fixed by validation before target-view predictions are read. All test-grid rows are transparent ablations and must not be used to reselect lambda.
